t: You're at Camberwell Old Cemetery, in the London borough of Southwark. Several people are buried here. Albert Edward McKenzie, a young sailor who was awarded the Victoria Cross, lies here; he died in 1918, aged only twenty. The Irish author and journalist William Patrick Ryan is buried here too, along with the artist Frank Chesworth and James Waterlow, who died in 1876. Stanisław Nowak, who died in 2000, is also buried in this cemetery.
